1: // Simple top‑down endless runner targeting canvas with id "game"
2: (function() {
3:   // Enhanced graphics: background gradient, stars, and shaded shapes
4:   const stars = [];
5:   const maxStars = 100;
6:   for (let i = 0; i < maxStars; i++) {
7:     stars.push({ x: Math.random() * canvas.width, y: Math.random() * canvas.height, size: Math.random() * 2 + 1, speed: Math.random() * 0.5 + 0.2 });
8:   }
9:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
10:   // Audio setup using Web Audio API
11:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
12:   function playTone(freq, duration) {
13:     const oscillator = audioCtx.createOscillator();
14:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
15:     oscillator.type = 'sine';
16:     oscillator.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, audioCtx.currentTime);
17:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.1, audioCtx.currentTime);
18:     oscillator.connect(gain).connect(audioCtx.destination);
19:     oscillator.start();
20:     oscillator.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
21:   }
22:   if (!canvas) { console.error('Canvas #game not found'); return; }
23:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
24:   // set canvas size to fill parent
25:   canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
26:   canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600;
27: 
28:   const player = { x: canvas.width/2, y: canvas.height*0.8, size: 15, speed: 2 };
29:   const keys = { ArrowLeft: false, ArrowRight: false };
30:   const obstacles = [];
31:   let distance = 0;
32:   const obstacleSpawnInterval = 1000; // ms
33:   let lastSpawn = 0;
34: 
35:   // Input handling
36:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
37:   // resume audio context on first interaction
38:   if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume();
39:   if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'ArrowRight') {
40:     keys[e.key] = true;
41:     // play movement sound: different freq for left/right
42:     const freq = e.key === 'ArrowLeft' ? 440 : 660;
43:     playTone(freq, 0.08);
44:   }
45:     if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'ArrowRight') keys[e.key] = true;
46:   });
47:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => {
48:     if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'ArrowRight') keys[e.key] = false;
49:   });
50: 
51:   function spawnObstacle() {
52:     const size = 20 + Math.random()*10;
53:     const x = Math.random() * (canvas.width - size);
54:     obstacles.push({ x, y: -size, size, speed: 2 + Math.random()*2 });
55:     // play spawn sound
56:     playTone(300, 0.05);
57:   }
58: 
59:   function update(dt) {
60:     // move stars (background)
61:     for (let i = stars.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
62:       const s = stars[i];
63:       s.y += s.speed;
64:       if (s.y > canvas.height) {
65:         s.y = 0;
66:         s.x = Math.random() * canvas.width;
67:       }
68:     }
69:     // move player
70:     if (keys.ArrowLeft) player.x -= player.speed;
71:     if (keys.ArrowRight) player.x += player.speed;
72:     // keep in bounds
73:     player.x = Math.max(player.size, Math.min(canvas.width - player.size, player.x));
74: 
75:     // move obstacles
76:     for (let i = obstacles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
77:       const o = obstacles[i];
78:       o.y += o.speed;
79:       if (o.y > canvas.height) obstacles.splice(i, 1);
80:     }
81: 
82:     // spawn
83:     if (performance.now() - lastSpawn > obstacleSpawnInterval) {
84:       spawnObstacle();
85:       lastSpawn = performance.now();
86:     }
87: 
88:     // collision detection (simple AABB vs triangle point)
89:     for (const o of obstacles) {
90:       const dx = Math.abs(player.x - (o.x + o.size/2));
91:       const dy = Math.abs(player.y - (o.y + o.size/2));
92:       if (dx < player.size && dy < o.size/2) {
93:         // game over
94:         alert('Game Over! Distance: ' + Math.floor(distance));
95:         // reset
96:         obstacles.length = 0;
97:         distance = 0;
98:         player.x = canvas.width/2;
99:         break;
100:       }
101:     }
102:     distance += dt * 0.1; // arbitrary scaling
103:   }
104: 
105:   function draw() {
106:   // background gradient
107:   const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, canvas.height);
108:   bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#001');
109:   bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#000');
110:   ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
111:   ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
112: 
113:   // draw stars
114:   ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
115:   for (const s of stars) {
116:     ctx.beginPath();
117:     ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
118:     ctx.fill();
119:   }
120:     // fade previous frame for motion blur effect
121:     ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.2)';
122:     ctx.fillRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);
123:     // draw player triangle pointing up with gradient
124:     const playerGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(player.x - player.size, player.y - player.size, player.x + player.size, player.y + player.size);
125:     playerGrad.addColorStop(0, '#0ff');
126:     playerGrad.addColorStop(1, '#00f');
127:     ctx.fillStyle = playerGrad;
128:     ctx.beginPath();
129:     ctx.moveTo(player.x, player.y - player.size);
130:     ctx.lineTo(player.x - player.size, player.y + player.size);
131:     ctx.lineTo(player.x + player.size, player.y + player.size);
132:     ctx.closePath();
133:     ctx.fill();
134:     // draw obstacles (triangles pointing down) with gradient shading
135:     for (const o of obstacles) {
136:       const obsGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(o.x, o.y, o.x + o.size, o.y + o.size);
137:       obsGrad.addColorStop(0, '#f44');
138:       obsGrad.addColorStop(1, '#800');
139:       ctx.fillStyle = obsGrad;
140:       ctx.beginPath();
141:       ctx.moveTo(o.x, o.y);
142:       ctx.lineTo(o.x + o.size, o.y);
143:       ctx.lineTo(o.x + o.size/2, o.y + o.size);
144:       ctx.closePath();
145:       ctx.fill();
146:     }
147:     // draw score with glow
148:     ctx.fillStyle = 'gold';
149:     ctx.font = '20px sans-serif';
150:     ctx.shadowColor = 'gold';
151:     ctx.shadowBlur = 8;
152:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + Math.floor(distance), 10, 30);
153:   }
154: 
155:   let lastTime = performance.now();
156:   function loop() {
157:     const now = performance.now();
158:     const dt = now - lastTime;
159:     lastTime = now;
160:     update(dt);
161:     draw();
162:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
163:   }
164:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
165: })();
